seo.title: ODDspace — creative workspace and community in Vallila, Helsinki
seo.description: A shared workspace in Vallila with desks, studios, gallery and event space for people working across creative and cultural fields.

title: A place to work, meet and make things.
intro: ODDspace is a shared space in Vallila for people working across art, culture, design, media, business and other creative fields. There are desks, studios, meeting rooms, a gallery and event space — and, more importantly, other people around. It is still a pilot, and the place is meant to keep changing with the people using it.

features.title: Work here
features.body: 24/7 access to shared workspaces, with no fixed desk and room to move around.

features.title: Use the space
features.body: Studios, meeting rooms, gallery and event space for work that needs more than a laptop.

features.title: Shape it together
features.body: A growing mix of people working under the same roof — and a space that evolves through what they bring to it.

whatItIs.headline: Sometimes creativity just needs somewhere to happen.
whatItIs.body: Creative work needs very practical things: a desk, a room, equipment, other people, time and somewhere to keep going after one project ends. ODDspace is our attempt to make more of that available under one roof — affordably, year-round and with enough freedom for the place to become something we could not have designed alone.

community.headline: Different practices. Same roof.
community.body: Artists, designers, producers, writers, founders, curators, makers and people who do not fit neatly into one title. You do not need to work the same way as everyone else. The point is to have enough different people around that useful conversations can happen without scheduling a networking event.

location.headline: Vallila. Teollisuuskatu 9D.
location.body: ODDspace is at Teollisuuskatu 9D in Vallila, inside Sture697. The neighbourhood already has studios, venues, workshops and creative businesses in every direction. We would rather add to that life than build an island of our own.

faq.question: How do I become a member?
faq.answer: Apply through the contact form below with a note on how you'd like to use the space. Memberships are accepted on a rolling basis as space becomes available during the pilot.

faq.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
faq.answer: No — it's a flexible monthly membership with no long-term commitment during the pilot phase.

faq.question: Can I rent the gallery or auditorium without being a member?
faq.answer: Get in touch — the rates above are member pricing; non-member rates are set case by case.

faq.question: What's included in the 150€/month membership?
faq.answer: Full, 24/7 access to the co-working space, studios and meeting rooms, plus member rates on the gallery and auditorium.

faq.question: Where exactly is ODDspace?
faq.answer: Teollisuuskatu 9D, in Vallila, Helsinki — part of the Sture697 development.

faq.question: Can I visit before applying?
faq.answer: Yes — mention it in your message below and we'll set up a time to show you around.
